exposure: abdominal adhesions at the time of gynaecologic surgery
Body mass index (BMI) at cesarean section
cohort: Women undergoing benign hysterectomy and/or adnexal surgery in Sweden between 2000-2014, with a previous delivery during 1973-2013
finding: Presence of adhesions in abdominal gynaecological surgery is associated with women's personal history of caesarean delivery.
mod_finding: The number of caesarean sections was the important predictor of adhesions; advanced age, obesity and postpartum infection further increased the incidence.
